lines.en: label kaoridate1:
: I wonder what Kaori is up to right now...
lines.zh: : 不知道 Kaori 这会儿在干什么呢……

lines.en: "I haven’t tried contacting Kaori ever since I got her phone number the other day, so
lines.zh: 「前几天拿到 Kaori 的电话号码之后，我一直没试着联系过她，所以

lines.en: I figure now is as good a time as any to get that ball rolling."
lines.zh: 我想，现在正是把这件事推起来的好时机。」

lines.en: How that ball will end up when rolling in the direction of someone as...eccentric as her, I have no idea. But it’s at least worth a kick or two.
lines.zh: 这颗球朝着她那样……古怪的人滚过去，最后会滚成什么样，我毫无头绪。不过至少值得踢上两脚。

lines.en: I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点下手机里 Kaori 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: : Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Did I make a mistake?
lines.zh: : 我做错什么了吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Kaori. That isn’t how you answer the phone.
lines.zh: : 是的，Kaori。电话不是这么接的。

lines.en: : Apologies. I think I meant to say hello.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想我要说的应该是你好。

lines.en: : This is the Hamburger Man, yes?
lines.zh: : 是汉堡人吧？

lines.en: : Correct. Do you not have me saved in your contacts or something?
lines.zh: : 没错。你没有把我的号码存进联系人什么的吗？

lines.en: : There are no names in my contact list. Only the colors I expect people to like the most.
lines.zh: : 我的联系人列表里没有名字。只有我猜每个人最喜欢的颜色。

lines.en: : You...saved my name as a color?
lines.zh: : 你……用一种颜色来记我的名字？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Well, what-
lines.zh: : 那么，是什——

lines.en: : Actually no.
lines.zh: : 其实不是。

lines.en: : For you, I wrote “clear.”
lines.zh: : 我给你写的是「透明」。

lines.en: : Clear isn’t a color...
lines.zh: : 透明又不是颜色……

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Okay, well-
lines.zh: : 好吧，那——

lines.en: : What are you currently participating in, Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 你此刻正在参与什么呢，汉堡人？

lines.en: : Me? Nothing. I called because I was wondering if-
lines.zh: : 我？什么都没干。我打电话过来，是想问问——

lines.en: : Let us go on what humans call a “date!”
lines.zh: : 我们去做人类所谓的「约会」吧！

lines.en: Woah, already?
lines.zh: 哇哦，这就来了？

lines.en: Kaori moves quick.
lines.zh: Kaori 推进得可真快。

lines.en: : Uhh, are you sure you’re okay with that? I kind of figured you’d want to at least talk more before-
lines.zh: : 呃，你确定这样没问题吗？我还以为你至少想再多聊几句再——

lines.en: : Come to this address.
lines.zh: : 来这个地址。

lines.en: I immediately receive a text from Kaori with nothing but numbers.
lines.zh: 我立刻收到了 Kaori 发来的短信，里面除了一串数字什么都没有。

lines.en: : Uh...Kaori?
lines.zh: : 呃……Kaori？

lines.en: : Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 汉堡人。

lines.en: : I need the name of the street too.
lines.zh: : 我还需要街道的名字。

lines.en: : Do humans give names to streets the same way they award them to children for being born?
lines.zh: : 人类给街道起名字，是不是跟给刚出生的孩子取名一样？

lines.en: : Kind of? Yeah. It's the name on the-
lines.zh: : 差不多？是的。就是那个名字，写在——

lines.en: : I remember now! Prepare for the beep!
lines.zh: : 我想起来了！准备听提示音吧！

lines.en: The beep happens, I guess.
lines.zh: 那声提示音，大概是响了吧。

lines.en: And, in other news, I have a full address now.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：我现在有完整地址了。

lines.en: : Why is your body not in the same place as mine yet?
lines.zh: : 为什么你的身体还没有出现在和我相同的地方？

lines.en: : Probably because I can't teleport.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我不会瞬移。

lines.en: : That makes sense!
lines.zh: : 有道理！

lines.en: I take another look at the address she texted me and realize that it isn’t too far from here.
lines.zh: 我又看了一眼她发来的地址，发现离这儿不算太远。

lines.en: I recognize the street name, but I’m not sure where I’ve seen it before.
lines.zh: 我认得那条街的名字，但不确定自己以前在哪儿见过。

lines.en: : I'll head over in a few minutes, I just need to get dressed and-
lines.zh: : 我几分钟后就过去，我只需要换好衣服，然后——

lines.en: : I understand!
lines.zh: : 我明白了！

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: Aaaand, she’s gone.
lines.zh: 然、后，她挂了。

lines.en: scene black
Shrugging off Kaori’s interesting end to our conversation, I get myself together and begin to head over to the address she sent me.
lines.zh: 我把 Kaori 那别开生面的收尾方式抛到脑后，收拾好自己，动身前往她发给我的那个地址。

lines.en: As soon as I set foot outside, I accept that there is absolutely no way this is a real date.
lines.zh: 一踏出门，我就接受了这样一个事实：这绝对不可能是真正的约会。

lines.en: Even knowing that, though, I can't help but be a little intrigued by the prospect of getting to see what makes Kaori tick.
lines.zh: 不过即便知道这一点，我还是忍不住有点好奇，想看看 Kaori 到底是个怎样的人。

lines.en: Here's hoping that she's a bit more...grounded today.
lines.zh: 但愿她今天能稍微……接地气一点。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate0
: So that's why the address looked familiar...
lines.zh: : 难怪这个地址看着眼熟……

lines.en: I don't know why I even expected something else in the first place.
lines.zh: 我真不知道自己一开始为什么会期待别的结果。

lines.en: I stand in the lobby, waiting for Kaori to show up and explain why we’re here on her day off.
lines.zh: 我站在店堂里，等着 Kaori 出现，解释一下为什么她休息日我们还约在这儿。

lines.en: Or at least what I {i}hope{/i} is her day off.
lines.zh: 至少我{i}希望{/i}今天是她的休息日。

lines.en: A few customers busy eating their breakfast stare at me and make me feel slightly uncomfortable...but my “date” shows up seconds later to either quell that or make it ten times worse.
lines.zh: 几个正忙着吃早餐的顾客盯着我看，让我有点不自在……但几秒钟后，我的「约会对象」就出现了，不知是来化解这份不自在，还是让它翻上十倍。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate1
: You came!
lines.zh: : 你来了！

lines.en: : I came. It would have been rude for me to tell you I’m coming and then just...not show up.
lines.zh: : 我来了。我都说了要来，然后又不出现，那也太失礼了。

lines.en: : Yes! That would have been a very bad thing!
lines.zh: : 是的！那会是一件非常糟糕的事！

lines.en: : But you are here! And now the human date can begin!
lines.zh: : 但你来了！那么人类约会现在可以开始了！

lines.en: : Just “date,” Kaori...
lines.zh: : 只是「约会」而已，Kaori……

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate2
: This language perplexes me.
lines.zh: : 这门语言真让我困惑。

lines.en: : The trick is to just not add “human” before every single object.
lines.zh: : 诀窍就是别在每一个东西前面都加上「人类」。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate3
: What does it mean to be “human?”
lines.zh: : 「人类」到底是什么意思？

lines.en: Oh no. She’s turning into Maya.
lines.zh: 哦不。她要变成 Maya 了。

lines.en: : Let’s not worry about that for now. Would you mind explaining why we’re hanging out at the diner on your day off?
lines.zh: : 这个我们先不操心。你能解释一下，为什么你休息日我们还要约在餐厅吗？

lines.en: : I figured you’d want to go somewhere else since you’re probably cooped up in here for an indeterminate amount of hours each week.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会想去别的地方，毕竟你每周大概都要在这里关上数不清的小时。

lines.en: : Day off? What is this “day off” you speak of?
lines.zh: : 休息日？你说的「休息日」是什么？

lines.en: Yup. Saw that coming.
lines.zh: 没错。早料到了。

lines.en: : It...means a day that you’re not working.
lines.zh: : 就是……你不用上班的一天。

lines.en: : But I am working. That is why we’re at the diner.
lines.zh: : 可我在上班啊。所以我们才在餐厅。

lines.en: : Kaori, why would you invite me here while you're working?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你为什么要在上班的时候把我叫到这儿来？

lines.en: : Is this not how a regular {i}date{/i} works?
lines.zh: : 普通的{i}约会{/i}难道不是这样进行的吗？

lines.en: : Nope. A “date” is what you call it when two people who are romantically interested in one another go do stuff together.
lines.zh: : 不是。「约会」是指两个对彼此有恋爱兴趣的人一起出去做点什么。

lines.en: : Oooooh...I see.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦……我明白了。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate4
: Wait, what?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！

lines.en: : What is this romantic interest you speak of?!
lines.zh: : 你说的这个恋爱兴趣到底是什么？！

lines.en: : To think that I would make such a mistake in the heat of human mating season!
lines.zh: : 没想到我竟会在人类交配季的白热化阶段犯下这种错误！

lines.en: : You can do it, Kaori!
lines.zh: : 你可以的，Kaori！

lines.en: : We believe in you!
lines.zh: : 我们相信你！

lines.en: : What are we supposed to do now?!
lines.zh: : 那我们现在该怎么办？！

lines.en: : Relax. I kind of expected this was a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 放松点。我早就料到这是个误会了。

lines.en: : Has the...time finally come to prepare my body?...
lines.zh: : 难道……终于到了该准备我身体的时候了吗？……

lines.en: : Kaori, why do you remember that? It was such a small part of that meeting.
lines.zh: : Kaori，你怎么会记得那个？那次会上只是很小的一部分啊。

lines.en: : Besides, Rin would kill me if we were to do that while she's not here.
lines.zh: : 再说，要是趁 Rin 不在的时候做那种事，她会杀了我的。

lines.en: : How many humans must be present for the mating ritual to be successful?...
lines.zh: : 交配仪式要成功，必须有多少人类在场？……

lines.en: : Just two. But there will be no mating ritual today.
lines.zh: : 两个就够了。不过今天不会有什么交配仪式。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate5
: Okay...I will trust you, Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我信任你，汉堡人。

lines.en: : But only because you are one of the few people in this city that I know by name.
lines.zh: : 但这只因为你是这座城市里我为数不多能叫出名字的人之一。

lines.en: : But you don't-
lines.zh: : 可你并不——

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate6
: Hamburger Man, would you like to consume hot meat with me for the breaking of my lunch?
lines.zh: : 汉堡人，你愿意在午休的时候陪我一起吃点热肉吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. Are you really going to take your lunch break this early, though? It’s not even 10:00 AM yet.
lines.zh: : 呃……好啊。不过你真的要这么早就午休吗？现在连上午十点都不到。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate7
: You traversed many miles of harsh terrain in order to reach me and all {i}I{/i} did was misunderstand the meaning of the word “date.”
lines.zh: : 你跋涉了数英里的险恶地形才来到我身边，而{i}我{/i}所做的，却只是误解了「约会」这个词的意思。

lines.en: : Now you must return home without having mated and it is all my fault.
lines.zh: : 现在你必须一无所获地回家，没能完成交配，而这全都是我的错。

lines.en: : It wasn't even a two mile walk and I made like one turn. I will accept your apology for the mating thing, though.
lines.zh: : 那段路连两英里都不到，我也就拐了一个弯。不过关于交配那件事，我接受你的道歉。

lines.en: : I will take my break early to spend time with the Hamburger Man. It is how I will correct my error.
lines.zh: : 我要提前休息，好和汉堡人多待一会儿。我就是要这样来弥补我的过错。

lines.en: : You really don't have to-
lines.zh: : 你真的不用——

lines.en: : Please give me 300 seconds to tell the computer that I am hungry.
lines.zh: : 请给我 300 秒，去告诉电脑我饿了。

lines.en: : Sure. Go tell the computer, Kaori. I'll wait here.
lines.zh: : 好。去告诉电脑吧，Kaori。我在这儿等。

lines.en: : Thank you. I will return with slightly more freedom than I have right now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。等我回来，会比现在稍微自由一点。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate0
Kaori disappears into the back room, leaving me once again uncomfortable and the center of attention.
lines.zh: Kaori 消失进后厨，又一次把我留在一群目光的中心，浑身不自在。

lines.en: scene black
I avert the gazes of various customers and take a seat at the closest booth, waiting for the Mistress of the Dark or whatever it is she calls herself to come back...
lines.zh: 我避开各路顾客的视线，在最靠近的卡座坐下，等着那位「黑暗女王」——或者不管她自称什么——回来……

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate8
Kaori places a, you guessed it, hamburger in front of me and takes a seat on the opposite side of the table.
lines.zh: Kaori 在我面前放下一个——你猜对了——汉堡，然后在桌子对面坐下。

lines.en: Honestly, if given the chance, I would have much preferred ordering something else this morning.
lines.zh: 说实话，如果可以选，我今天早上更想点别的什么。

lines.en: I love hamburgers, don’t get me wrong, but I love them significantly more when it isn’t 10:00 AM and I’m still trying to wake up.
lines.zh: 别误会，我很喜欢汉堡，但如果不是上午十点、我还没完全醒过来的时候，我会更喜欢它们。

lines.en: : I am very glad that we are currently engaged in a real human date, Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴我们现在正在进行一场真正的人类约会，汉堡人。

lines.en: : Kaori, I already told you this isn't a real date. Please try to remember the meanings of things from now on as it will save both of us a great deal of time.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我已经说过这不是真正的约会了。以后请努力记住这些东西的意思，这样能给我们俩都省下大量时间。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate9
: But these customs and meanings are so hard to keep track of! I am just a girl with a spider tattoo and extra colors in my eyes, not a dictionary!
lines.zh: : 可是这些习俗和意思太难记了！我只是个身上有蜘蛛纹身、眼睛里有额外颜色的女孩，又不是一本词典！

lines.en: : Wait, are those actually your real eyes?
lines.zh: : 等等，那真的是你本来的眼睛？

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate10
: Of course. Where would I procure fake ones?
lines.zh: : 当然。我上哪儿去弄假的眼睛？

lines.en: : I...have no idea. I was just under the impression those were colored contacts or something.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。我只是以为那是美瞳什么的。

lines.en: : Aren't contacts the names of the colors in your telephone?
lines.zh: : 联系人不就是你电话里那些颜色的名字吗？

lines.en: : Kaori, what planet were you born on?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你到底出生在哪颗星球上？

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate11
: I believe they told me it was some place called...Gunma?
lines.zh: : 我记得他们告诉过我，是一个叫……群马的地方？

lines.en: : Wait, who are {i}they?{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，「{i}他们{/i}」是谁？

lines.en: : Also, there's no way that's true. Gunma is in Japan.
lines.zh: : 而且这不可能。群马就在日本啊。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate12
: Hamburger Man! Don’t tell me you have forgotten where we are?
lines.zh: : 汉堡人！别告诉我你忘了我们在哪儿？

lines.en: : Do you require medical assistance? I am trained in CPR. Can you breathe? How many colors are there in the rainbow?
lines.zh: : 你需要医疗救助吗？我受过心肺复苏训练。你能呼吸吗？彩虹有几种颜色？

lines.en: : I don’t require medical assistance, Kaori. I just don’t understand how you’re still coming to terms with normal human behavior if you were born in Japan.
lines.zh: : 我不需要医疗救助，Kaori。我只是不明白，如果你出生在日本，怎么会到现在还在慢慢适应普通人类的行为。

lines.en: : It might sound crazy, but I was starting to think you were some sort of...alien or robot or something.
lines.zh: : 这听起来可能很疯狂，但我都开始觉得你是某种……外星人或者机器人之类的了。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate13
: That sounds very crazy. You are a crazy person. I am suddenly the normal person here.
lines.zh: : 这听起来确实很疯狂。你才是那个疯狂的人。这么一来，我反倒成了这里正常的那一个。

lines.en: : I still think I have a bit of an edge, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 不过综合来看，我还是觉得自己稍微领先一点。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate14
: Wrong. You still have much to learn from me, grass-bug.
lines.zh: : 错。你还有很多要跟我学的，草虫。

lines.en: : It’s “grasshopper.”
lines.zh: : 是「蚱蜢」。

lines.en: : I make the rules here, grass-bug. Not you.
lines.zh: : 这里规矩由我定，草虫。不是你。

lines.en: : I’m actually kind of getting used to Hamburger Man, so if we can stick with that instead of grass-bug, it would be much appreciated.
lines.zh: : 其实我已经有点习惯「汉堡人」了，所以如果能继续用那个、别叫草虫，我会非常感激。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate15
: Good! Hamburger Man is a good name. And very fitting for someone who likes hot meat as much as yourself.
lines.zh: : 好！汉堡人是个好名字。而且对像你这样喜欢热肉的人来说非常贴切。

lines.en: : However!
lines.zh: : 不过！

lines.en: : However what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : I like the new name too! So I hereby pronounce you...
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢那个新名字！所以我在此宣布你是……

lines.en: : Hamburger-bug!
lines.zh: : 汉堡虫！

lines.en: : Okay, that’s the worst nickname so far. Please don’t ever call me that again.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这是目前为止最糟的外号。请你以后永远别这么叫我。

lines.en: : Are we going to go on more “dates” in the future? Or do we need to “hang the outs” first? That is a term I learned recently!
lines.zh: : 我们以后还会进行更多「约会」吗？还是说要先「出去逛一逛」？这是我最近学到的说法！

lines.en: : Either you have the worst teacher in the world or you are gravely misremembering it.
lines.zh: : 要么你有个全世界最差的老师，要么你记错得离谱。

lines.en: : Please explain the process we must go through to become closer, Hamburger-bug Man! I must learn more things!
lines.zh: : 请告诉我，要变得亲密需要经过哪些流程，汉堡虫人！我必须学会更多东西！

lines.en: : You know, I'm just going to go ahead and assume you {i}are{/i} romantically interested in me if you keep calling this a date.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，如果你继续把这叫约会，那我就直接当你{i}是{/i}喜欢我了。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate16
: No! I am simply curious!
lines.zh: : 不！我只是好奇！

lines.en: : You have many interesting words and stories to share!
lines.zh: : 你有很多有趣的词和故事可以分享！

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate17
: I do not have many colors in my phone...
lines.zh: : 我手机里没有很多颜色……

lines.en: : Sometimes, when I think I’ve made what you would call a {i}friend...{/i}the friend just disappears.
lines.zh: : 有时候，当我以为自己交到了你们所说的「{i}朋友{/i}」……那个朋友就会消失。

lines.en: : They all keep going away and I don’t understand why.
lines.zh: : 他们一个个都离开了，而我不明白为什么。

lines.en: : What am I doing wrong, Hamburger-bug-burger-man-bug?
lines.zh: : 我到底做错了什么，汉堡虫堡人虫？

lines.en: : Kaori, can I ask you something? And don’t take this the wrong way.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我能问你一件事吗？别误会我的意思。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate18
: I will do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。

lines.en: : Do you...really talk like that on purpose? Or is it just a sort of...self-defense mechanism or something?
lines.zh: : 你……真的是故意那样说话的吗？还是说那只是某种……自我防卫机制什么的？

lines.en: : Like, you’re only talking that way because you want to stand out or seem unique in someone else’s eyes.
lines.zh: : 比如，你那样说话只是因为你想显得出众，或者在别人眼里显得独一无二。

lines.en: : Because if it’s anything like that, I want you to know that-
lines.zh: : 如果真是那样的话，我想让你知道——

lines.en: : Talk like what? I don't understand.
lines.zh: : 那样说话？我不明白。

lines.en: : Is this about adding “human” to words again?
lines.zh: : 又是因为我在词前面加「人类」吗？

lines.en: : Uhh, well yeah. That’s...definitely part of it.
lines.zh: : 呃，算是吧。那……肯定是其中一部分。

lines.en: : What are the other parts?
lines.zh: : 那其他部分呢？

lines.en: : I lack the type of education that you provide when you aren’t trafficking humans, but I am trying my best to learn.
lines.zh: : 我没有你提供的那种教育——在你不贩卖人口的时候——但我在尽最大的努力学习。

lines.en: : First off, please stop saying I’m a human trafficker.
lines.zh: : 首先，请别再说我是人口贩子了。

lines.en: : Second, the way you talk now is perfectly fine as long as you’re not intentionally trying to sound weird.
lines.zh: : 其次，只要不是故意想让自己听起来怪怪的，你现在说话的方式就挺好的。

lines.en: : Learning a language is tough. And I’m not sure how you got to the point you’re at now, but I’m glad to see you’re trying to get better.
lines.zh: : 学一门语言很辛苦。我不知道你是怎么走到今天这一步的，但我很高兴看到你在努力变好。

lines.en: : Just...keep practicing or something. A lot.
lines.zh: : 只要……继续练就行。多练。

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate19
: Thank you Hamburger-bug! I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，汉堡虫！我真的很感激。

lines.en: : Please stop calling me that.
lines.zh: : 请别再那么叫我了。

lines.en: : I understand!
lines.zh: : 我明白了！

lines.en: : Since you have been a good person to me, I will give you a new name instead!
lines.zh: : 既然你对我这么好，那我就给你换个新名字吧！

lines.en: : What is it this time? Grassburger? Hamhopper?
lines.zh: : 这次是什么？草堡？汉蚱？

lines.en: : No! It is better!
lines.zh: : 不！这个更好！

lines.en: : You are now...
lines.zh: : 你现在是……

lines.en: scene kaorifirstdate20
: Friend!
lines.zh: : 朋友！

lines.en: scene black
Kaori and I talk for another twenty minutes before her break ends and she has to get back to work.
lines.zh: 我和 Kaori 又聊了二十分钟，直到她的休息结束、得回去工作。

lines.en: Not wanting to disturb her anymore, I pay the bill and take my leave.
lines.zh: 不想再打扰她，我付了账便离开了。

lines.en: Somehow, and I really don’t understand it- but I feel like I learned a lot about Kaori today.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的——我也真的说不上来为什么——但我感觉今天对 Kaori 了解了很多。

lines.en: That feeling drifts away the second I realize I could have probably talked her into giving me a discount, though.
lines.zh: 不过，当我意识到自己本来大概能说服她给我打个折时，这份感觉就烟消云散了。

lines.en: Either way, I consider today's meeting a good first step in what I can now confirm is some sort of...friendship.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我认为今天的见面是个不错的开端，通向某种我现在可以确认的……友谊。

$ kaoridate1 = True
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!{/i}
